usage: 炒蓮藕 is a noun referring to a stir-fried lotus root dish.
You can use 炒蓮藕 when ordering food in a restaurant or talking about dishes at home.
It commonly appears as a dish name after verbs like 食 (eat), 叫 (order), 煮 (cook), or 整 (make).
炒蓮藕 can be used with measure words, for Example:  一碟炒蓮藕 or 兩碟炒蓮藕.
It can also be used in questions about preference or taste, such as: 你鍾唔鍾意食炒蓮藕？
